thread:
samir: Quick sync — proposing an interleaved bump across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Idea is staggered roll: API -> runtime -> console -> SDKs over 3 days to minimize breakage. Can we list the minimal compatibility checks and ownership for each step?
anna: SGTM. What's the exact order you want? API first because it’s the surface. runtime second for binary/weights compatibility. console third to update UI, then SDKs last to pick up client changes.
leo: Agree with that. For runtime I want an explicit KV-format compat check and a small perf smoke. I can own runtime tests.
maya: I can take console churn and changelog anchor. I’ll prep a single changelog entry template that cross-links PRs.
frank: I’ll coordinate release windows. Proposed windows: Day1 10-12 PST for API cut, Day2 09-11 PST runtime, Day2 16-17 PST console, Day3 09-10 PST SDKs. Does that work for on-call?
samir: @frank that schedule looks fine. @leo thanks — can you add the KV dump+load test to infra and post the command?
leo: Pushed a tiny test script to infra repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842. Run:
```bash
./tools/run_kv_compat.sh --from=stable --to=canary --sample 1000
```
Expect <1% mismatch, otherwise fail the cut.
maya: Changelog template is here: https://git.redwood/changelogs/templates/bump-anchor.md. I’ll add the API/runtime/console/SDK PR ids there. Use "anchor: interleaved-bump-211000" as the id.
anna: For the API bump: I’ll open a PR that keeps old endpoints aliased for one minor release (compat shim). API owners: @samir @anna. Please review when I draft.
samir: Will review. Also note console has a small schema change for response_fields. Console must tolerate missing fields for two releases. @maya add that in the changelog note.
frank: Heads-up: if any repo needs a manual DB migration do it during the scheduled window, otherwise postpone.
leo: Runtime artifact naming changed (we add -q4 suffix). SDKs must map model names. I’ll publish a compatibility mapping JSON in runtime PR. SDK owners should ingest it during their cut.
maya: Console will read mapping from /meta/models.json for the next two releases. I’ll leave fallback logic: prefer new name, fall back to mapping, then old name.
frank: Quick checklist for owners:
- API: alias endpoints, open PR, include tests (owner: anna)
- Runtime: KV compatibility smoke, publish model mapping JSON (owner: leo)
- Console: schema tolerance + changelog anchor (owner: maya)
- SDKs: implement mapping ingest + bump deps (owners: TBD)
samir: Can someone volunteer for SDKs? I can help with JS SDK, but we need a Go and Python owner.
anna: I’ll pick Python SDK. @frank can you ask engineering leads for Go owner?
frank: Yep, will ping leads.
devops-bot: Reminder: schedule has been added to the release-calendar: https://calendar.redwood/releases/211000-interleaved-bump. No override conflicts detected.
leo: Small note — if runtime perf regresses >5% we automatically rollback runtime and alert owners. Confirmed?
frank: Confirmed. Add post-deploy KPI check to the runbook.
maya: I’ll create the changelog anchor PR now and tag the known PRs as they land.
anna: Drafting API PR, will tag @samir for review. One more ask: can we gate SDK publish with an integration test that hits a smoke hosted endpoint?
samir: Yes — publish only after passing integration smoke against canary API and runtime. Use env var CANARY_URL.
leo: I added a small script to run both smoke and mapping checks:
```bash
./tools/release_gate.sh --canary $CANARY_URL --mapping runtime/mapping.json
```
That will exit non-zero on failures.
frank: Final note — please add short changelog lines under the anchor like: "runtime: artifact name change (-q4); api: backward alias; console: tolerant schema; sdk: mapping ingestion". Keep entries one-liners.
samir: Thanks all. I’ll open a tracking issue and add links to each PR as they appear. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
